value.rationale: The crosspolytope is an exact geometric forbidden core for a natural all-dimensional random-section combinatorial event. An explicit positive probability beyond its boundary and dimension-dependent (d−1)-order onset give quantitative structure not inferable from means of face counts. All reference points and all d≥3 are covered, and d=3 admits a closed elementary law, giving motivated uses in geometric probability and polytope section theory.
